run_asr_inference: run speech recognition inference on pre-processed data with a trained fairseq model
run_inference_with_viterbi_decoder: run ASR inference using the viterbi w2l decoder for speech recognition
dump_model_emissions: dump model emissions to a numpy file for later offline decoding
dump_model_features: dump encoder features from the model to a numpy file for analysis
run_inference_with_loaded_emissions: run ASR inference using pre-saved emissions loaded from a numpy file
